_about: Sessellift Stern Q-4: the second Sessellift fixed-grip terminal style (owner, 2026-11-02), a bottom drive that carries the tensioning and a fixed top return, built from the owner's two vector layouts (Gate 0, local reference; drawn at 1:100 and 1:78.5). Millimetres in the lift frame: u toward the other terminal, v right looking along u, w up; origin on the bullwheel axle at the loading level 0.00. The layouts load up the left rope; ours load up the right, so the model is their deliberate mirror. Bottom drive only (owner): the drive carries the bottom head and the return the top head, and neither gains the other end's. The chairs, line towers and sheave rows are the FGQ-4's (the kit's). A narrower model moves what carries or guides the rope with the gauge (the LD5 rule; assets/stern_heads.py): values given against the rope ('in', 'out', 'foot', 'head') are distances outboard (+) or inboard (-) of it, the bullwheels' plates follow the gauge, and the hood, piers, column, boom and decks keep the quad's size.

common.loadedRope: right looking along u: v+ at the drive (bottom), v- at the return (top)

drive._note: The bottom drive: a portal at the line end (two legs 9.49 m apart under a crossbeam) carries two arms forward to the hold-down rows; a frame runs back from it into the hood, which bridges 12 m to a tapered column; the bullwheel hangs under the hood on the tensioning carriage (static, owner). No conveyor or pit (owner).

hood._note: The end profile (v, w), half, from the bottom edge up and over the crown; the line end raked as drawn (u at w); the far end plumb.

return._note: The fixed top return: a steel column 1.81 m along the line by 0.61 m across, a boom 2.2 m back to the hub under the exposed bullwheel, a railed deck over the wheel's inner half, guide sheaves 2.3 m ahead of the wheel, and the line frame ahead of the column: a truss out to a crossbeam with the support rows and a lifting portal over them.

bullwheel._note: return_terminal.bullwheel's exposed wheel; the top plate as drawn (2,292 radius, 3,128-3,182 high)

lineFrame._note: a truss on the axis from brackets on the column: an upper member and a lower strut meeting at a post under the crossbeam

top._note: the FGQ-4 drive's 4-sheave support trains on plates at the crossbeam ends; the 6 and 8 sheave rows (the line towers' kit) as the other fixed grips' top heads
